data_description.username: Wyze or 3rd party OAuth email address

data.bulb_local_control: Use Local Control for Color Bulbs and Light Strips

data_description.bridge_url: go2rtc API address for Wyze cameras, such as http://127.0.0.1:1984. Card previews load from /api/frame.jpeg. Leave blank to skip.
data_description.bridge_stream_url: rtsp://host:8554/{{name}} for Wyze cameras. {{name}} is the camera nickname, lowercased, with spaces as underscores.
data_description.bridge_rtsp: Play Wyze cameras from the bridge stream URL instead of Wyze cloud WebRTC. Lights and other devices are unchanged.

error.bridge_stream_required: Enter a camera stream URL to play from the bridge

entity_changed.title: Wyze Entity Error
entity_changed.description: {automation} may need attention. {entity} may have changed or been removed. This is due to a change in outdoor plug devices. Once fixed you can ignore this issue.

device_changed.title: Wyze Device Error
device_changed.description: {automation} may need attention. A device has changed or been removed. This is due to a change in outdoor plug devices. Once fixed you can ignore this issue.
